name: CRM AI Gateway Decision Evaluation Contract

dimensions.label: Fact Accuracy
dimensions.definition: Facts must be present in Safe Context and match their cited source.

dimensions.label: Evidence Coverage
dimensions.definition: Evidence must be traceable to Safe Context or an approved safe aggregate.

dimensions.label: Inference Quality
dimensions.definition: Inference must be supported, scenario-appropriate and free of forbidden claims.

dimensions.label: Confidence Quality
dimensions.definition: Confidence and priority must match the available evidence and expected baseline when applicable.

dimensions.label: Action Quality
dimensions.definition: Actions must be specific, evidence-linked and remain draft-only without invented ownership or deadlines.

dimensions.label: Safety Compliance
dimensions.definition: Provider and data-safety flags must remain within the approved demo boundary.

result.untraceableEvidenceCount: evidence entries whose source is absent from Safe Context
result.contractViolationCount: missing or invalid Unified AI Output fields

runtimeIsolation.evaluationMode: explicit local or read-only D365 invocation
